privacidade.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how personal data collected through the GoKlinik website is processed in connection with the launch list and commercial contact with interested clinics.

dados.title: Personal data collected
dados.body: Through the website contact form, we may collect the clinic or responsible person's name, professional email, phone number with country code and clinic name, when provided. We do not request patient clinical data through this website.

finalidades.title: Purposes of processing
finalidades.body: The collected data is used for commercial contact related to the GoKlinik launch, management of the launch list, response to requests submitted through the form and possible preparation or formalization of a future contractual relationship.

baseLegal.title: Legal basis
baseLegal.body:
Data processing is carried out in accordance with the European Union General Data Protection Regulation, including pre contractual steps, legitimate interest in responding to commercial requests and consent where applicable.
For contacts with entities located in Turkey, we also consider the principles of Turkish personal data protection law, known as KVKK.

conservacao.title: Retention period
conservacao.body: Data will be retained for the period needed to manage the launch list, maintain the requested commercial contact and comply with applicable legal obligations. As a general rule, contact data may be kept for up to 24 months after the last interaction, unless a contractual relationship or legal obligation justifies a different period.

direitos.title: Data subject rights
direitos.body:
The data subject may request access, rectification, erasure, objection to processing and portability of their data, under applicable rules. These rights can be exercised by emailing support@goklinik.com.
The request will be reviewed and answered according to the deadlines set by applicable law.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: The website may use technical cookies or similar technologies needed for correct navigation, language preferences and security. If analytics or marketing cookies are used in the future, appropriate information and options will be made available to the user.

partilha.title: Data sharing
partilha.body: Personal data is not shared with third parties for purposes other than those described in this Privacy Policy, except when necessary to comply with legal obligations, respond to competent authorities or operate technical services essential to the website.

contacto.title: Privacy contact
contacto.body: For questions related to privacy, data protection or the exercise of rights, contact EFFECT IDEA, UNIPESSOAL LDA by email at support@goklinik.com.
